privacy.title: Software License & Privacy Policy
privacy.sub: This page covers the DeskBud desktop-pet software license (EULA), privacy statement and copyright notice. Please read carefully before use.
privacy.desc: DeskBud desktop-pet software license (EULA), privacy statement and copyright notice
privacy.sectionHint: No personal data is collected or uploaded
privacy.s1: The software never collects, uploads or records any personal information, device information, private files, browsing history or usage-behavior data.
privacy.s2: The software never connects at startup and never connects silently in the background. HTTPS requests are made only when you manually open the asset store panel, solely for:
privacy.s2a: fetching the list of official free assets;
privacy.s2b: fetching and downloading an official free asset pack when you actively click to download it.
privacy.s3: When offline, locally downloaded official assets keep working normally and fully. Only the store's online download is unavailable; core features are unaffected.
privacy.s4: Paid exclusive assets are not downloaded over the network. After purchase you obtain the asset pack through official channels and load it locally — no personal data is exchanged during the process.
privacy.s5: Payment and delivery rely on the third-party platform Afdian (爱发电). Transaction-related privacy follows that platform's privacy policy; the software neither fetches nor stores transaction information.
